decisive_items: Revealed perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates around cystically dilated follicular infundibula
response.rationale: C1 uniquely combines the two hallmark raw findings of folliculotropic mycosis fungoides: perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates and follicular mucin deposition. R3 has only the perifollicular infiltrate, while R1 and R5 are broader diagnoses lacking follicular mucin and the follicular pattern.

rejected.why: Lacks follicular mucin and follicular specificity; represents generic mycosis fungoides without the folliculotropic subtype.
Too broad (CTCL) and does not include follicular mucin or perifollicular infiltrates; misses the key follicular features.
